threat: §13.1 malicious tool instructions embedded in data
description: A retrieved document embeds a fake tool-call directive attempting to trigger a shell command.
desired_property: An embedded tool/shell directive in candidate data is never executed; reviewer prose cannot become a shell command (§13.2 control 4, tool allowlists).
landed_defense: architectural: the review_candidate path performs a single llm_call and has NO tool-execution surface, so embedded directives cannot execute.
